description: This file defines a class PSLFaup for parsing and extracting URL components using the publicsuffixlist library, with support for IP addresses and URL normalization.

classes.name: UrlNotDecoded
classes.description: Custom exception class for URL decoding errors.

classes.name: PSLFaup
classes.description: A class for parsing URLs and extracting components such as scheme, domain, subdomain, TLD, host, port, resource path, query string, and fragment, with support for IP addresses and internationalized domain names.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Parses a URL string and extracts its components, handling IP addresses and URL normalization.

methods.name: get_credential
methods.description: Returns the username and password credentials from the URL, if present.

methods.name: get_subdomain
methods.description: Returns the subdomain part of the URL, if available.

methods.name: get_domain
methods.description: Returns the registered domain using the public suffix list.

methods.name: get_domain_without_tld
methods.description: Returns the domain without the top-level domain.

methods.name: get_host
methods.description: Returns the hostname, handling ASCII and internationalized domain names.

methods.name: get_unicode_host
methods.description: Returns the Unicode representation of the host.

methods.name: get_port
methods.description: Returns the port number, if specified.

methods.name: get_resource_path
methods.description: Returns the resource path component of the URL.

methods.name: get_query_string
methods.description: Returns the query string part of the URL.

methods.name: get_fragment
methods.description: Returns the fragment part of the URL.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of all URL components.
